newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS BOURSE OK'S VOLOS TECHNICAL RIGHTS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS BOURSE OK'S VOLOS TECHNICAL RIGHTS ISSUE.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange approved the 3.036 billion drachma rights issue of Greek construction firm Volos Technical , it said in a statement.

Volos Technical will issue 2.76 million new common registered shares with a par value of 125 drachmas each, entitling existing shareholders to one new share per two outstanding at 1,900 drachmas each.
Proceeds from the rights issue will be used to inject capital into consortia in which Volos technical participates. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
